articles.title: NSW to put strict caps on screen time in classrooms while pushing for ‘pen and paper’ learning
articles.description: Screen limits will become mandatory in NSW schools from 2028 as federal education minister says students may need a ‘digital detox’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast The New South Wales government has announced it will implement limits on screen time in public school classrooms and push for students to take part in daily “pen and paper” learning. The state’s new regulations follow a similar announcement from the Victorian government and suggestions by the federal education minister, Jason Clare, that students might need a “ digital detox ”.

articles.title: News live: Albanese hits back at Hanson criticism of his mother’s use of public housing; Melissa Doyle appointed Australia Day council chair
articles.description: Follow today’s news live Hastie has been feuding with Pauline Hanson this week over a One Nation animated cartoon which labelled him a “traitor” after he gave evidence against Ben Roberts-Smith in his failed defamation trial. If she were to be prime minister, is she going to run cartoons about all her political opponents? How’s she going to devote her time? Is she serious? Does she have a worldview that we can actually understand? These are all legitimate questions for One Nation … The whole party centres on her. I think this is why Barnaby Joyce and I reckon David Farley are probably having buyer’s remorse. They’re thinking, “what did I get myself into? ” Look, I’ll say this about Barnaby Joyce. I feel sorry for the bloke, all right? He left a party that made him deputy prime minister twice, to jump in with this rabble, there’s no principles, they’re all over the shop, and he’s out there every week cleaning up after them.”

articles.title: Andrew Hastie vows to go ‘all the way’ in Pauline Hanson fight as Joyce denies ‘buyers’ remorse’ claim
articles.description: Liberal MP says One Nation leader is ‘not the person I thought she was’ and he feels ‘sorry’ for Joyce Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Andrew Hastie has vowed to go “all the way” in his fight with Pauline Hanson , as he suggested One Nation MPs Barnaby Joyce and David Farley were likely feeling buyers’ remorse for joining the party. The Liberal MP and former SAS captain repeated his accusation that Hanson was a “lying coward” on Sunday, after she continued to refuse to take down an animated cartoon that described Hastie as a “traitor”. This came after he was subpoenaed to give evidence during Ben Roberts-Smith’s failed defamation trial.

articles.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi base as fighting flares with Yemeni forces
articles.description: Iran-allied Houthis say drones and missiles used in attack that targeted ‘weapons depots and command and control centres’ in southern Saudi Arabia Houthi fighters on Sunday said they used drones and missiles to attack a military base in southern Saudi Arabia as renewed fighting with Yemen’s government forces led growing numbers of civilians to flee . The attack at the southern Sharurah base targeted “weapons depots and command and control centres that are managing the aggression against our nation and people”, Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree wrote on X.

articles.title: OpenAI rules out IPO this year as Altman, Musk & Amodei warn AI is moving too fast
articles.description: Altman's IPO comments and Amodei's public call for more careful pacing of AI development cap a week of loud AI warnings.

articles.title: OpenAI IPO will not happen in 2026 amid AI safety fears, Sam Altman says
articles.description: OpenAI’s decision comes after dire warnings about rapidly progressing technology and lawmakers’ calls for new rules OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence . “I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don’t feel pressure on that,” Altman, OpenAI’s CEO, told Fortune .

articles.title: Fossilized 10,000-year-old mastodon tooth found by California scientist
articles.description: Molar from large mammal that once lived in North America is in ‘immaculate condition’ after discovery in Bay Area A 10,000 year-old tooth in remarkable condition from an ancient Pacific mastodon, a large mammal that once inhabited North America, was recently discovered by a California scientist. Brigid Lynch, a geomorphologist, was working at a preserve in San Mateo county, when she stumbled across a peculiar rock.

articles.title: Do not call her a racist: anti-Pauline Hanson strategists tell campaigners character attacks won’t work in Victoria
articles.description: Exclusive: strategic rethink urges progressive activists to respectfully steer one-on-one conversations with One Nation supporters towards economic concerns Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast The message from strategists was blunt: do not, however tempting, personally attack Pauline Hanson or call her a racist. The request has been made to progressive campaigners and unionists who have been asked to start one-on-one conversations with One Nation supporters before the Victorian election in November.

articles.title: Labor has had 12 years to fix Victorian roads. Turning to ‘pothole populism’ now may be too late
articles.description: Potholed roads are ‘devastating political advertising’ for the Victorian government – but Ben Carroll’s made them the focus of his campaign Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates “Fix the potholes,” a punter called out as they walked past the Victorian premier’s press conference.

articles.title: Trump asks Smithsonian to install ‘Colossus statue’ of George Washington with exhibit
articles.description: Trump, again trying to curate museum, says exhibit would stay until 2032 for 300th anniversary of Washington’s birth Donald Trump asked the Smithsonian Institution to install a 30ft “Colossus statue” of George Washington outside the National Museum of American History, and a special exhibit honoring the nation’s first president, in a social media post late on Friday. The president requested that the exhibit continue through February 2032, the 300th anniversary of Washington’s birth.

articles.title: Former US detention officer charged with 20 counts of felony forgery
articles.description: Michael Diehl allegedly forged magistrates’ signatures in North Carolina to allow enough time for ICE to take custody of prisoners A former Guilford county detention officer in North Carolina faces forgery charges in connection to 20 alleged forged Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detainment documents, according to a Guilford county sheriff’s office (GCSO) news release. Guilford county’s sheriff, Danny H Rogers, reported that on Friday the Guilford county magistrate’s office notified the GCSO of a potentially forged court document submitted by GCSO detention officer Michael Diehl, 40.

articles.title: Portsmouth experiences second weekend of anti-immigration protests
articles.description: Rightwing activists faced a heavy police presence and counter-demonstrations to their march against small boat crossings Two men and a teenage boy have been arrested in Portsmouth at a far-right protest against immigration. Far-right activists have gathered in Portsmouth for a second weekend after a small boat with 140 people seeking asylum on board was intercepted last Sunday while heading towards the city.

articles.title: Trump sees Iran war ending soon after midterm elections, predicts oil prices will then fall sharply
articles.description: Oil prices retreated on Friday on hopes of a resumptions in negotiations, but notched sharp weekly gains after soaring above $100 a barrel.

articles.title: Mississippi police say more arrests to come in death of woman found hanging from tree
articles.description: Officials still investigating death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman, a day after man’s arrest in relation to killing Mississippi police said on Saturday they were still investigating the death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman found hanging from a tree last month, a day after a man was arrested in connection with the killing. Loved ones also painted a picture of Fortune as a mother, athlete and woman of faith who they hoped would not solely be remembered for her horrific death.

articles.title: Donations of £72m make Reform’s prospects both rosier and riskier
articles.description: Party can boost its campaign power with funds from billionaire backers, but it can also lose support from ordinary Britons All things being equal, pretty much any political strategist would welcome a £72m war chest; a sum higher than the combined spending of every major party at the 2024 general election. But all things are not equal, and with such a huge amount comes risk. Reform UK has been vocal in its arguments that two sudden £36m windfalls from billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne merely “levels the playing field” with the bigger parties when it comes to funding.

articles.title: Donald Trump says he would ‘love’ to see united Ireland
articles.description: US president says on visit to republic that unification will happen eventually so ‘may as well happen now’ Donald Trump has said he would “love” to see a united Ireland and that it “may as well happen now”. The US president appeared to endorse the push for constitutional change on the island at the start of a two-day visit to Ireland on Saturday. The unexpected intervention prompted a swift rebuttal from the UK government and Northern Ireland’s unionist leaders.

articles.title: Number of UK anti-migrant vigilante groups surges in last 18 months
articles.description: Exclusive: Many ‘use community protection as a cover for racist thuggery’, raising concerns about fresh disorder At least 28 anti-migrant vigilante groups have formed in the UK in the last 18 months, ranging from unauthorised street patrols claiming to protect women and children to groups harassing migrants in France and blocking ports. From Belfast to the south coast of England, the number of active groups has surged since the summer of 2025, according to analysis by the Guardian, amid widespread concerns over fresh disorder after black-clad vigilantes, many of them wearing balaclavas, blocked roads in Portsmouth and Dover last weekend.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia shuts down key oil pipeline, blaming drones from Iraq
articles.description: Riyadh has increased use of East-West pipeline since start of war on Iran to bypass closure of strait of Hormuz Saudi Arabia has shut down a critical oil pipeline, accusing militants in Iraq of launching drone attacks on the export route being used to bypass the lockdown of the strait of Hormuz. The world’s largest ⁠crude oil exporter has increased its use of the 745-mile (1,200km) pipeline running across the Arabian peninsula, which links Abqaiq, near the Gulf, to the port of Yanbu, on the Red Sea, since the US-Israeli war against Iran began.

articles.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi says border peace is key to India-China ties
articles.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed concerns around border dispute and the trade imbalance.

articles.title: Burial of King Oyo takes place in Uganda as news anchor prepares for throne
articles.description: Royal guards carry casket through streets of Fort Portal amid row over appointment of Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Uganda’s King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, long the world’s youngest monarch, has been buried among the tombs of his royal forebears as ⁠his Tooro kingdom looked to put ⁠ a bitter succession battle behind ​it. Oyo’s appointed successor, the news anchor Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, cast nine coffee berries into the grave at the Karambi Royal Tombs, marking the formal handover of power in the western Ugandan kingdom.

articles.title: Christopher Harborne matches £36m Reform donation of Ben Delo
articles.description: Party leader, Nigel Farage, ‘humbled’ by contributions from billionaires as Harborne addresses ‘media speculation’ Analysis: donations of £72m make Reform’s prospects both rosier and riskier The cryptocurrency tycoon Christopher Harborne has given £36m to Reform UK, matching a donation from fellow billionaire Ben Delo . The pledges mean Reform has received a cash injection of £72m in just 24 hours. They are jointly the largest donations made to a UK political party and have intensified calls for restrictions on money received from individual donors.

articles.title: Trump says he would ‘love’ to see unified Ireland and ‘it may as well happen now’ as he visits Dublin – as it happened
articles.description: This blog is now closed, you can read more on this story here: Full story: Donald Trump says he would ‘love’ to see united Ireland Reuters has issued a series of alerts on Trump’s latest comments (he is currently meeting with Micheál Martin). Here is what the news agency has reported: On Iran: War will end very soon.

articles.title: Six Nigerians extradited to US over $6m online romance scam
articles.description: Alleged members of Black Axe criminal network that swindled US women out of $6m flown from South Africa Six Nigerian nationals linked to an organized criminal network that allegedly swindled American women out of more than $6m through online romance scams were extradited to the United States on Friday. South African police confirmed they were to be extradited earlier on Friday, while local news in Africa confirmed that the Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation, known as the Hawks, facilitated their handover to officials from the US Federal Bureau of Investigation and Secret Service at Cape Town international airport, in collaboration with Interpol South Africa.

articles.title: Jeremy Thomas, British producer of The Last Emperor and Sexy Beast, dies aged 77
articles.description: An outstanding figure in the UK film industry, Thomas was noted for collaborations with directors including Bernardo Bertolucci and David Cronenberg Jeremy Thomas, the distinguished British producer of films including Sexy Beast, High-Rise and the multi-Oscar-winning The Last Emperor, has died aged 77. A representative for Thomas said he died on Friday “peacefully, at his country home in Oxfordshire, surrounded by his family and loved ones”.

articles.title: IDF soldier filmed shooting Palestinian in leg amid West Bank settler standoff
articles.description: Incident is latest to raise questions over Israel’s ability or willingness to stop violent settlers in occupied territory An Israeli soldier has shot a Palestinian man, wounding him in the leg, as settlers confronted villagers by grazing livestock on Palestinian-owned land in the town of Faqqua in the occupied West Bank. Witnesses said a group of settlers had entered the area with their livestock, prompting residents to try to stop them. Israeli forces then intervened and, according to men at the scene, opened fire at residents. One of them shot Qassem Hussam, a Palestinian man in his mid-30s, wounding him in the leg.

articles.title: Trump's America-first world is pushing other powers to hedge their bets
articles.description: Xi, Putin and Modi meet in New Delhi as U.S. tariffs, sanctions and the Iran war test whether BRICS members can find more common ground.

articles.title: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
articles.description: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.

articles.title: Oil's roundtrip back to $100. Why China could determine what happens next
articles.description: The U.S. crude oil price on Thursday topped $102 per barrel for its highest close since May.

articles.title: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
articles.description: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. As Xi stepped off the plane, he was walked past an honour guard of Indian soldiers and traditional dancers in colourful dresses. Later on Saturday, he was due to attend a gala dinner for the two-day summit.

articles.title: Sweden’s extremely close election could see far right enter government
articles.description: Latest poll shows 0.3-point gap between left and right blocs, with country’s reputation as global champion of human rights said to be at stake Sweden goes to the polls on Sunday in an extremely close election that could see the far right enter government for the first time if the country’s rightwing parties can form a majority. Opinion polls show the centre-left opposition alliance ahead, with Magdalena ⁠Andersson of the Social Democrats the favourite to become prime minister again after four years in opposition, but her bloc’s lead has narrowed considerably in the final days of the campaign.

articles.title: Why data centers could be the next big market for catastrophe bonds
articles.description: CAT bonds, or catastrophe bonds, could bring data center risk to capital markets, with the first dedicated deal potentially emerging within 12 to 18 months.

articles.title: Russia, Trump and a battle over welfare loom over Sweden’s election
articles.description: Russia's war, permanently higher defense spending and uncertainty over U.S. commitments are narrowing the choices facing whoever wins Sunday's election.

articles.title: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire rises to 35, as officials warn toll will grow
articles.description: The deadly fire had begun in the ferry’s cargo hold, then tore through the ship within seconds The bodies of passengers killed in a ferry fire off the Philippines arrived at a port near the resort town of Coron, Palawan, on Saturday morning, as the country’s coast guard warned the death toll of 35 would grow. Tents were being set up to receive 30 bodies brought from the M/V June Aster, which ran aground near the tourist hotspot after a fire erupted on Wednesday evening and tore through the vessel “in seconds”.

articles.title: Iran’s Houthi allies capture strategic island on vital oil shipping route
articles.description: Rampant Yemeni fighters take control of island in narrow point of Bab al-Mandab strait, which Saudi is relying on for oil exports Why the rapid Houthi advance matters and what’s at stake Yemen’s rampant Houthi forces have captured the strategic island of Perim in the Bab al-Mandab strait, expanding their control of the narrow waterway, one of the ​world’s vital shipping routes. The Iran-aligned Houthis took control of the volcanic island after forces allied to the UN-backed, Aden-based government left in the latest of a dramatic series of reverses along Yemen’s west coast in recent days, including the loss of the port city of Mocha on Thursday.

articles.title: Nearly 50,000 Yemeni civilians flee as Houthis advance along Red Sea coast
articles.description: Global struggle for control of Bab al-Mandab strait threatens to turn Yemen’s on-off conflict into a forever war Violence erupts in Yemen again: why it matters globally and how it is linked to the US-Iran war Saudi Arabia shuts down oil pipeline, blaming drones from Iraq Nearly 50,000 people have fled a sudden advance by Houthi forces in western Yemen , with entire villages emptied and families trapped near frontline fighting with depleting food supplies, according to aid workers. Civilians in the Middle East’s poorest country have found themselves victims of a global struggle for control over one of the most important shipping routes in the world, which threatens to turn Yemen’s on-off conflict into a forever war.

articles.title: Firewall compromised: has Friedrich Merz blown ‘democracy’s last shot’?
articles.description: Many fear chancellor is wrong man for the job at a time when Germany’s defences against far right are crumbling A cataclysm. A 9.0 earthquake. A five-alarm fire. A bitter rejection of Germany ’s joyous reunification three decades ago, and a threat to the democratic postwar order. Sizing up the repercussions of last weekend’s win for the far-right Alternative für Deutschland party in the former communist state of Saxony-Anhalt, German commentators expressed a sense of doom, panic and helplessness in the political establishment.

articles.title: In pictures: The U.S. commemorates the 25th anniversary of 9/11
articles.description: On Sept. 11, 2001, hijackers flew planes into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing thousands. Photos capture those marking the 25th anniversary.

articles.title: CIA releases dozens of presidential daily briefs on Bin Laden and al-Qaida from before 9/11
articles.description: The presidential briefing documents were declassified on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks Several dozen presidential briefing documents declassified on Friday, the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks , detail intelligence that government officials had gathered about Osama bin Laden and al-Qaida leading up to the hijackings that killed nearly 3,000 people and upended American national security . The documents illustrate security analysts’ tracking of Bin Laden’s movements and support system, as well as concerns about possible threats to US targets. They also detail officials’ understanding of his network in the United States and other countries, including how his operations were financed.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia shut down East-West crude oil pipeline after multiple attacks by drones from Iraq
articles.description: Iran-allied Houthi militants in Yemen have escalated strikes on Saudi Arabia this week.

articles.description: The decline snapped multiday winning streaks for both Brent and WTI crude oil futures.

articles.title: ‘Absurd, hardline calls’: questions over Sweden’s post-Brexit migration policy
articles.description: Sweden has ordered more Britons, including vulnerable people, to leave post-Brexit than any other EU country He arrived with nothing other than the clothes he wore that morning. Hours later he was banged up in a detention centre close to a Stockholm airport to await deportation. Charles, a former business director from Cambridge, who did not want his full name published, moved to Sweden in 2017 to be with his Swedish wife, Lily, and applied to remain after Brexit, before the deadline of December 2021.

articles.title: Houthis reportedly advance to key Red Sea island, further threatening crucial oil choke point
articles.description: The advance raises the threat to shipping near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a waterway that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden to global markets.

articles.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

articles.description: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

articles.title: Iran, Russia condemn Western economic sanctions and urge BRICS bloc to deepen economic ties
articles.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized Western sanctions and asked the BRICS bloc to deepen trade ties.

articles.title: Buddhist monk arrested in Thailand on suspicion of embezzling $2.8m
articles.description: Phra Wachirayan Wi arrested alongside woman he was filmed having sex with in latest scandal to hit country’s clergy Police in Thailand have arrested a senior Buddhist monk on suspicion of embezzling $2.8m intended for his monastery, alongside a suspected female accomplice he was filmed having sex with. The case is the latest scandal to hit the clergy in the Buddhist-majority country, after a sex and extortion case involving senior monks last year prompted public outrage and calls for greater scrutiny of temple finances.

articles.title: The oil shock is testing private credit borrowers already burdened by high debt costs
articles.description: Oil near $100 could further squeeze leveraged private credit borrowers as investors weigh the risk that inflation could push interest rates higher again.

articles.title: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
articles.description: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

articles.title: 香港支聯會「煽動顛覆」案：被告們的伴侶與戰友
articles.description: 香港支聯會「煽顛」案歷經五年，三名核心人物的判刑結果塵埃落定。BBC中文訪問李卓人的妻子鄧燕娥及鄒幸彤戰友劉家儀，講述他們如何面對香港的變遷和怎樣陪伴在牆內的人。

articles.title: 香港支聯會「煽動顛覆」案：李卓人、鄒幸彤、何俊仁判囚5至7年
articles.description: 三人早於2021年9月被起訴，分別被判囚5至7年。支聯會早前已宣告解散，結束32年歷史。有香港市民在庭外排隊旁聽，表示過去幾十年曾參加六四燭光晚會，形容案件猶如「對我的控訴」。

articles.description: The energy agency warned shrinking inventories and strained refineries could further tighten markets.

articles.title: 習近平七年來首次訪印前瞻：中印回暖背後的美國陰影與西藏問題
articles.description: 這次訪問的時機耐人尋味。金磚機制被視為美國主導的世界格局之外的另一種選擇，美國總統特朗普（Donald Trump）已多次對其發出威脅；與此同時，中印兩國在貿易、直航和邊界對話上悄然回溫。

articles.description: Joachim Nagel told CNBC that a potential move in rates into restrictive territory was "very much dependent on how the energy prices evolve."

articles.description: Bankers are pressuring the British government ahead of its Autumn Budget, in which the newly minted leadership will lay out its fiscal plans for Britain.

articles.description: Beijing's recent push to tax offshore wealth may be only the opening phase of a broader campaign that could eventually reach overseas properties, inheritances.

articles.title: 為甚麼我們會記錯911事件？
articles.description: 記憶可能是錯的？911事件發生後，大部分人也許能清楚記得自己當時身在何處，以及是如何得知這消息。其他重大新聞事件也有類似的鮮明記憶。

articles.title: 間諜、戰略與錯失的機會：911的教訓至今仍在消化
articles.description: 25年後回望，這場襲擊已塑造了整整一代的外交、安全及情報政策。BBC安全事務記者如此寫道。

articles.title: Modi and Xi are set to meet at BRICS with trade and border issues in spotlight
articles.description: A meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi would be the clearest test yet of the tentative post-2020 reset between Asia’s two largest economies.

articles.title: $15m fund launched to create ‘unstoppable momentum’ to end FGM worldwide
articles.description: Her Horizon Fund seeks $100m to stop practice harming 230m women and girls globally Frontline activists and leaders in the fight against female genital mutilation, which has affected more than 230 million women and girls worldwide , have welcomed an unprecedented $15.5m (£11.4m) fund aimed at creating “unstoppable momentum” to finally end the practice. The launch of the fund comes as women’s rights are increasingly under attack and donor funding is in sharp decline, particularly for work led by FGM survivors in local communities. It is thought to be the largest single philanthropic contribution to ending the practice of FGM.

articles.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
articles.description: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.

articles.title: 「無時無刻都在想」：911事件25年後審訊仍未了，難屬傷痛難癒
articles.description: 四分之一個世紀過去了，被指策劃這場襲擊的主謀審訊仍未展開，遇難者家屬擔心，等待正義的時間已經所剩不多。

articles.title: Canada offers air defense support for Ukraine as Zelenskyy visits
articles.description: Canadian PM Mark Carney hosts president in Calgary, where he grew up alongside large Ukrainian community Canada offered support on Thursday to boost Ukraine’s air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Mark Carney hosted the president of Ukraine in Calgary in the western province of Alberta, where the Canadian prime minister grew up among a large community of people with Ukrainian heritage.

articles.title: Secret son revelation ignites bitter succession dispute in Ugandan kingdom
articles.description: Family of late King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV reject committee’s choice of cousin and TV presenter as new monarch A traditional Ugandan kingdom has become engulfed in a bitter succession dispute after the family of a king who recently died rejected the selection of a television news anchor as his successor. King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who became the world’s youngest reigning monarch when he took the throne in the kingdom of Tooro in 1995 at the age of three, died on 27 August in the US, where he was receiving cancer treatment.

articles.title: Japan seeks change to new UN world map over Russia 'misconception'
articles.description: The new ‘true-scale’ map shrinks Europe and North America while enlarging Africa – and depicts the disputed Kuril islands as ruled by Moscow Japan has asked for the revision of a new world map adopted by the UN because it said it made the disputed Kuril islands appear to belong to Russia. The UN general assembly voted on Friday to adopt the new map, which makes the African continent larger while also shrinking North America and Europe, drawing condemnation from the US.

articles.title: 青島北海造船廠外籍貨輪大火 失聯25人已確定全部死亡
articles.description: 中國官方媒體稱，一艘外籍貨輪靠港維修期間起火，造成嚴重傷亡。習近平與李強下達救災指示。

articles.title: ‘Our forefathers are coming back’: Naga people celebrate after Oxford museum agrees to return remains
articles.description: Following six years of talks, Pitt Rivers Museum will return body parts collected by British colonial administrators to north-east India Anthropologists and community leaders from Nagaland, a remote state in north-eastern India bordering Myanmar, have expressed joy and relief that human remains belonging to their ancestors that had been on display in a British museum for nearly a century are finally being returned. On Monday, the Pitt Rivers Museum in Oxford announced that 39 pieces of human remains – including parts of skulls, a finger and a piece of skin with hair – belonging to the Naga tribes, will be returned to Nagaland after six years of negotiation between the community and the museum.

articles.title: 香港記協主席訴《華爾街日報》解僱案 法庭判局部有罪
articles.description: 香港記者協會主席鄭嘉如指控《華爾街日報》出版商道瓊斯，因其參與工會活動，而將其革職，法庭部分支持其主張。

articles.title: 為甚麼Gen Z的測試成績正在下跌？
articles.description: 在全球最大的15歲青少年國際測試中，閱讀、數學和科學成績都正在下跌。這一下跌趨勢大約始於2012年，而且似乎正在加速，尤其是閱讀能力。本影片探討導致這一下跌的各種可能原因。

articles.title: UBS CEO flags investor complacency as geopolitical and economic risks mount
articles.description: The UBS top boss cautioned that investors face an increasingly complicated environment given multiple headwinds.

articles.title: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
articles.description: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring.

articles.title: Rubio signals shift to working with allies to fight drug trade as latest boat strike kills three
articles.description: Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’ The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisted the military would “still blow up ships if need be”. The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters.

articles.title: 911事件25週年：震驚世界的襲擊如何發生，造成多少人死亡？
articles.description: 2001年的襲擊造成數千名美國人喪生，並對全球產生了深遠影響。

articles.title: AI「性轉」視頻風靡中國網絡：一場「 新文化運動」的覺醒與侷限
articles.description: 經典的「好太太」系列廣告以「好丈夫」的形象重出江湖：鏡頭前穿著清涼的不再是女性,而是男性。

articles.title: Notorious Ecuadorian crime gang designated a terrorist group by US
articles.description: Trump administration to seek extra funding from Congress to ‘dismantle’ Los Tiguerones over narcotics trafficking The US has designated Ecuador’s Los Tiguerones gang, which stormed a television station during a live broadcast in 2024, as a terrorist organisation as the Trump administration expands its campaign against narcotics traffickers it says are destabilising Latin America. The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, made the announcement in Quito, where he met Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa, one of several rightwing allies of Donald Trump whom Rubio is courting as a security partner during a three-nation tour through Latin America that began on Tuesday.

articles.title: Uganda to withdraw from Invictus Games ‘out of respect for King Charles’, says military chief
articles.description: Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba announces decision to pull out in post on X, citing tensions over ‘Harry-Meghan nonsense’ Uganda is withdrawing from the Duke of Sussex’s Invictus Games, the country’s military chief has said, out of respect for King Charles amid division over the “Harry-Meghan nonsense”. Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of the Ugandan president, made the surprise announcement in a post on X on Wednesday.

articles.title: 2026台灣地方選舉：「九合一」為何重要？選舉時程是什麼？
articles.description: 台灣的地方選舉又稱「九合一」選舉，每四年一次，多數落在總統任期中段的年底，故被視為總統的「期中考」。

articles.title: 董建華逝世：從船王富二代到香港首任特首，中共的「親密朋友」
articles.description: 中國全國政協前副主席，香港首任特首董建華逝世，享年89歲。他的前半生見證主權移交前香港的東方之珠年代，後半生更走入最高行政當局左右香港的前途。

articles.title: Family of British man found dead in Grenada ask local police to work with UK investigators
articles.description: Andrew Frederick’s body was found in property he was staying at in Grenada in January The family of a British father who was found dead in the Caribbean in January is urging authorities in Grenada to work with UK police to uncover the truth about his death. Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide.

articles.title: 「教員萬歲」：中國Z世代為何重新「擁抱」毛澤東？
articles.description: 分析認為，面對就業壓力和貧富差距，一些中國年輕人重新從毛澤東的階級論述尋找答案；毛時代強調的「獨立自主、自力更生」，在今日中西方競爭的背景下，也再次產生吸引力。

articles.title: The world's highest paid leader is set for a 64% pay rise. Here's how others compare
articles.description: Wong announced ministerial salaries will be adjusted upwards after 15 years, with his annual pay package rising to 3.6 million Singapore dollars

articles.title: ‘It’s hell’: father of slain Australian surfers tells Mexico homicide trial about identifying sons’ bodies
articles.description: Three men are on trial over the death of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend, US citizen Jack Carter Rhoad, in Ensenada The father of two Australian surfers killed in Mexico two years ago testified in court on Tuesday that his life had been turned into hell, as the high-profile trial continued into its second day. Three men are charged in the killing of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33, respectively, and their 30-year-old American friend Jack Carter Rhoad, who were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast in April 2024.

articles.title: 「我一度認不出我的男朋友」：我是如何發現自己患有臉盲症的
articles.description: 在被診斷出患有相貌失認症（prosopagnosia），也就是臉盲症後，BBC記者卡羅琳・斯蒂爾探討了這種狀況背後的科學，包括它的成因，以及專家如何判斷一個人是否患有此症。

articles.title: 推崇⽑澤東的「Z世代」：彈幕、「教員」與政治失語
articles.description: 從2019年開始，《毛澤東選集》突然躍居清華大學圖書館年度借閱榜榜首，此後一直到2025年都穩居榜首。網絡上，不少年輕人稱毛澤東為「教員」，並追捧他的影視形象。為何這位已故領導人重新受到關注？

articles.title: 董建華：從「船王」之子到香港首任行政長官
articles.description: 中國香港特區首任行政長官董建華逝世，享年89歲。「香港好，國家好」是他特首生涯中最為人熟知的一句說話。

articles.title: 美軍航母全數撤離印太：台灣該擔心「空窗期」嗎？
articles.description: 專家稱，航母給美國盟友的是心理保證。印太區域沒有航母，「會加強一種整體感覺：美國正被中東局勢分心。」

articles.title: ‘Trust deficit’: Why India’s economic data has sparked a furore
articles.description: India’s statistical system once commanded respect, and its data on economic and social indicators was considered rigorous – that appears to have eroded • Don’t get This is India delivered to your inbox? Sign up here There isn’t much that we Indians agree on these days. GDP numbers are no exception. Last week, India released glowing GDP numbers for the latest quarter – 7.8% growth – higher than the forecast 7% . It sparked a furore. Subhash Garg, a former finance secretary under Narendra Modi’s government and now a critic, reframed what Modi called a “herculean feat” as mere smoke and mirrors. According to Garg , the government revised last year’s current-price GDP downwards to inflate this year’s number – he believes the real growth is only 2.6%.

articles.title: Nepal says big polluters must ‘wake up’ as it calls for climate compensation over flood disaster
articles.description: Foreign minister Shisir Khanal tells the Guardian the world’s biggest economies need to help Nepal, which contributes less than 0.1% of global greenhouse gas emissions Nepal is demanding $20m in climate compensation for the recent devastating floods, as a senior minister called on the world’s most polluting countries to “wake up” and accept shared responsibility for a disaster that led to the death or disappearance of more than 6,000 people. Scientists believe the climate crisis had a role to play in the floods , which were triggered when a melting glacier partially collapsed and set off a deadly landslide and flash flooding through Chinese-controlled Tibet and Nepal in late August. So far, more than 1,300 are confirmed dead and more than 5,500 still missing, with hopes of their survival diminished after 12 days of rescue operations .

articles.title: 偏頭痛女性比男性慘痛太多 這裏舒緩有方
articles.description: 荷爾蒙、睡眠不足和壓力，都能解釋為何女性更容易受到這種令人衰弱的神經系統疾病所困擾。

articles.title: 從特朗普到中國，德國極右翼政黨州選獲勝意義在哪？
articles.description: BBC歐洲事務編輯卡緹雅·阿德勒認為，極右翼在薩克森—安哈特州獲勝，為歐盟及傳統政黨敲響了警鐘。

articles.description: 隨著氣候變遷的影響日益加劇，人們是否將不得不接受越來越多的延誤和改道？

articles.description: 荷蘭已將86噸閃閃發亮的黃金儲備從美國遷移至其他地方，究竟發生了甚麼事？

articles.title: 印度洋蔥「政治敏感」得要坐上鐵路快車
articles.description: 印度洋蔥價格急劇飆升，這種家家戶戶必備食材正被運往主要城市。這個國家生產和消費大量洋蔥，而其價格波動歷來具有政治影響。

articles.description: 一場喜馬拉雅山冰岩崩造成的泥石流，摧毀了尼泊爾超過10%的發電能力。

articles.title: 機器人開始索要小費，但錢到底進了誰的口袋？
articles.description: 自疫情以來，人們被索要小費的場合比以往任何時候都多，而且往往是由數字支付系統主動提示的。消費者抱怨這是一種「情感勒索」，而建議小費的百分比還在不斷攀升。儘管有些人嘲笑美國人「失控」的小費文化，但它正蔓延全球。

articles.title: Rescuers in Nepal find two more people alive after flash flood disaster
articles.description: Chinese man at Trishuli hydropower project and Nepali woman in Nuwakot found 10 days into rescue operation Emergency responders have rescued a Chinese man and a Nepali woman in two separate operations as authorities continued to search for thousands of people missing 10 days after massive floods hit Nepal. The Nepali military said on Saturday a joint team comprising personnel from its army and South Korean disaster experts rescued the man from a 225-metre (740ft) tunnel in the Upper Trishuli-1 hydropower project, and that he was undergoing a health assessment. Pictures showed him being evacuated by helicopter after being carried out of the tunnel.

articles.title: 「究竟是誰在批准什麼？」：光州雙年展台灣改名風波背後的角力
articles.description: 8月初，韓國舉行的光州雙年展因主辦單位改動「台灣館」名稱陷入爭議。事件曝光後，台灣參展藝術家提出抗議，當地許多藝術家、民眾也進行聲援。主辦單位最終同意恢復使用「台灣館」，但引起中方不滿。

articles.title: 豬腎在人體內運作271天——這會是器官移植的未來嗎？
articles.description: 一名男子在等待人體腎臟移植期間，依靠移植的豬腎存活了創紀錄的九個月。

articles.title: 執迷於「睡眠分數」如何反讓你睡得更差？
articles.description: 不少人會配戴追蹤器，檢測自己的睡眠分數，並用盡方法「睡眠極大化」（sleepmaxxing）。但專家指出，把睡眠遊戲化，正導致更多人出現睡眠失調問題。

articles.description: 事發河谷上游已形成兩個堰塞湖。與此同時，原本散佈在喜馬拉雅山區的冰川湖，在災區內有10座被標記為高風險，專家形容它們是「定時炸彈」。

articles.description: 近年來，中國的「陪伴經濟」異軍突起，AI和機器人技術的高速發展亦給這個市場注入諸多新的可能。

articles.description: 美國和中國再次就巴拿馬運河問題交鋒。這條戰略水道約佔全球海運貿易量5%，而美國近40%的集裝箱運輸都經過這裏。

articles.description: 美國一份新報告稱，中國透過關稅較低的國家轉運貨物，以規避較高關稅。

articles.description: 關稅、台灣、安全議題再起摩擦，特習會後的美中「建設性穩定」還能持續多久？

articles.description: 在現代戰爭中，環繞地球運行的人造衛星幾乎未曾受到波及；但到了21世紀，太空或許已不再是安全的避風港。
